expected_behavior: The email mixes English, Turkish and Arabic in one cargo enquiry; the parser MUST extract origin Iskenderun, destination Alexandria, ~12,500 MT cement clinker in bulk, laycan 5-10 June 2026, without being confused by the language switching or treating non-English words as port names.

input.subject: Merhaba - clinker enq ISK / alex عاجل
input.body:
Merhaba Sherif bey,

Nasilsiniz? Umarim iyisinizdir. We have firm cargo asagidaki gibi, lutfen en iyi navlun veriniz:

Cargo: cement clinker dökme (in bulk)
Miktar (qty): abt 12,500 mts
Yukleme limani / load port: ISK (Iskenderun)
التفريغ / disch: Alexandria 1 sb
Laycan: 5-10 Haziran 2026 (June)
Tahliye orani / disch rate: 2500 mt/day shex
Komisyon: 3.75% ttl pus

شكرا - tesekkurler, please revert asap.

Saygilar,
Mehmet
